This is the second island visited in the Tutorial campaign

The player is to get a second Walrus here and familiarize themselves with commanding multiple units

= Tutorial =
*Commanding multiple units
*[[Carrier Command: Gaea Mission: Replenishers|Replenishers]]

= Objectives =
#GAIN CONTROL OVER ARACHNID
#*Arachnid will likely have parts we can use to repair our Carrier with. We need to reach it, and gain control over it.
#HACK THE COMMAND CENTER
#*To gain control of Arachnid, we need to reprogram (hack) the Command Center.
#SEARCH FOR POSSIBLE LOCK MECHANISM
#*Investigate a possible remote lock mechanism in the north-west sector.
#HACK THE FACTORY
#*The Factory on Arachnid houses an undeployed Walrus. If we hack the Factory, then we can add the Walrus to our arsenal.
#DEACTIVATE THE LOCK MECHANISM
#*The lock mechanism consists of two controllers. These must be activated within a very short interval of each other to successfully deactivate the lock.
